# Filter pending requests from April or May 2023 and approve them
in_scope_ids = []
for req in received_requests:
    created = req['created_at']
    # created_at format: "2023-04-..." or "2023-05-..."
    if created.startswith('2023-04') or created.startswith('2023-05'):
        in_scope_ids.append(req['payment_request_id'])

print("In-scope IDs:", in_scope_ids)
print("Count:", len(in_scope_ids))

# Approve each in-scope request using Venmo balance (default)
for pid in in_scope_ids:
    result = apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(access_token=access_token, payment_request_id=pid)
